summary: Valens Semiconductor Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, reporting its second-quarter 2026 financial results via an earnings release (Exhibit 99.1). The company announced revenue of $18.1 million, exceeding guidance, and raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $78–81 million. It also disclosed the appointment of a new CFO and Head of Automotive Business Unit. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring; it is a routine earnings release and management announcement, thus not a special situation. Watch for continued automotive revenue ramp in 2027.
